title: phoebe estrellensis
intro: Phoebe estrellensis, commonly known as Estrella Phoebe or Estrella, is a plant species in the family Lauraceae. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine due to its various health benefits, which include the ability to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antibacterial properties. The therapeutic actions of Phoebe estrellensis include its potential to act as an antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and anti-diabetic agent. The bioactive constituents of this plant include lignans, terpenoids, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
